cohort: The study included 169,148 live-born infants with one or more major birth defects from the Texas Birth Defects Registry between January 1, 1999, and December 31, 2014, excluding those with chromosomal abnormalities, diagnosed syndromes, missing gestational age data, gestational age less than 24 weeks, and anencephaly.
finding: Overall, 51.7% of neonatal mortality in infants with birth defects is attributable to preterm birth, with the population attributable fraction varying significantly by the type of birth defect.
gest_age: Infants were categorized as preterm (<37 weeks) or term, with those under 24 weeks excluded.
